name: Hithium (Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd.)
old_description: Hithium is a Chinese battery energy storage system manufacturer that opened its first U.S. manufacturing/assembly plant in Mesquite, Texas in 2025 with 10 GWh annual capacity.
about:
Hithium, a Chinese battery energy storage system manufacturer, established its first U.S. manufacturing and assembly plant in Mesquite, Texas in 2025 with 10 GWh of annual capacity. The company, formally Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd., is headquartered in Mesquite. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the available information.

The company produces battery energy storage systems (BESS), battery modules, and stationary storage solutions. Its processes include BESS assembly and automated manufacturing. The Mesquite facility targets 10 GWh annual output, while global shipments have surpassed 200 GWh. The firm operates a "Lighthouse Factory" in Chongqing, recognized as the world's first for energy storage batteries.

Hithium serves utility, grid storage, commercial, residential, commercial & industrial (C&I), off-grid, and AI data center markets. Project examples include a 235 MWh installation in Colorado, a 150 MW/300 MWh system in Lianyungang, China, a 55 MWh project in Razlog, Bulgaria, a 421 MWh supply for GPG's Fraser Coast project in Australia, and a gigafactory investment in Navarre, Spain.

The company states its mission is to "let green energy benefit all, help strivers realize their dreams," with a vision to become a respected global green energy company with leading technology. It emphasizes end-to-end integrated capabilities, full-chain integration, and a "Li-Na Synergy" strategy combining lithium-ion and sodium-ion technologies.
